'''Lesser yams''' are an [[aboveground]] [[crop|garden plant]]. They can be planted in all seasons and are edible when [[cooking|cooked]].

Some [[Dwarf|dwarves]] [[preferences|like]] lesser yam plants for their ''tubers''.
